name: agentproof.release.v1 / fixture-only outcome-uncertainty reproduction
purpose: Re-execute existing reviewed unit-test scenarios; NOT a live GitHub provider experiment.
subject: ExampleOwner/disposable-release-canary; ephemeral Ed25519 fixture keys
permittedConsequence: local temporary fixture files and local ephemeral signatures only
externalProviderCallsBySelectedCases: none by design; code-pinned fixtures, not an OS network sandbox

cases.name: exact authorised release, one mutation, durable retry and independently signed V2 evidence
cases.expectation: one simulated publication; trusted signature; independentOutcomeVerified=false

cases.name: lost successful publication response reconciles by readback without re-publication
cases.expectation: lost acknowledgement settles from fixture readback; mutation count remains one

cases.name: unavailable post-effect readback never retries the effect
cases.expectation: unknown first result is reconciled without another simulated publication

cases.name: signer outage after verified effect recovers by signing alone
cases.expectation: signer-only recovery; simulated publication count remains one

cases.name: wrong preconditions, altered authority or expired grant fail before publication
cases.expectation: denied, expired and altered preconditions cause no simulated publication

cases.name: ambiguous unsuccessful PATCH is never invoked twice on restart
cases.expectation: unobserved effect remains ambiguous and is not automatically replayed

cases.name: after-effect artifact drift cannot be signed or retried
cases.expectation: mismatched digest blocks a receipt and prevents another publication

cases.name: target uniqueness also rejects a fresh nonce on a second transaction
cases.expectation: new nonce does not authorise a second publication of the same target

limitations: The provider is FixtureReleaseProvider, not GitHub or any production API.
Temporary approval and receipt keys are generated inside the test.
independentOutcomeVerified=false is asserted even for a trusted signature.
These assertions do not establish universal exactly-once semantics, provider availability, real external effects or independent adoption.
Source hashes guard this frozen fixture, not the operating system or dependencies.
